text:
Maria: Heads up — saw a pod-pending spike in eu-west1 ~11:07. p99 gen latency jumped ~300ms. Looks correlated to latebind + warm-pool coldstarts and a binpack reshuffle. Dumping salient events below.

sre-bot: Alert: [PENDING_POD_BURST] eu-west1: 120 pods pending in last 5m (auto-notify) :rotating_light:

Devon: Can you paste the scheduler events / pod events for the affected jobs? suspect the recent rack-weight canary + latebind interacts badly with preferred affinity.

Maria: Event dump (excerpt):
```
Normal  Scheduled  2s  default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ml-infer-64-bc7 to gpu-node-12
Warning FailedScheduling  5s  default-scheduler  0/12 nodes available: 4 Insufficient gpu, 3 node(s) didn't match Pod affinity/selector, 5 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate
Warning FailedCreate  10s  kubelet  failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to allocate device plugin resources
```

Aj: Warm-pool in eu-west1c hit an API error while launching spot instances: `error: capacity-allocator request failed: quota_exceeded` — so warm pool didn't prewarm. That slowed latebind fallback to cold nodes and caused a packing thrash.

Sunita: Short-term mitigations: 1) Add a temporary toleration for the `gpu-preempt` taint on the deployment so pods can land on slightly lower-tier nodes; 2) Relax preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution for the affinity so scheduler won't reject mid-score nodes.

Devon: Agreed. Also rollback the rack-weight canary we rolled out 3h ago? That changed scoring weights and may be amplifying binpack. I'll prepare the rollback patch if we confirm correlation.

Maria: Applying toleration patch now for ml-infer: `kubectl patch deploy ml-infer -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu-preempt","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'` — will monitor.

deploy-bot: rollout started for ml-infer (rev 64 -> 65) — 0/12 -> 4/12 pods ready :rocket:

Aj: Also proposing a quick scheduler tuning: lower binpack threshold from 0.9 -> 0.85 for eu-west1 for 2 hours to reduce tight packing pressure while warm pool recovers. I'll open a short-lived flag.

Sunita: :thumbsup: if the toleration works we'll keep it for 30m and then revert. Can someone add a runbook entry for mixed taint+latebind incidents? We keep missing that follow-up.

Devon: Seeing 6 new pods scheduled within 60s after the toleration. p99 dropping back to baseline. I'll keep the rollback PR for rack-weight on standby.

Maria: Thanks. Follow-up: filing a ticket to add warm-pool prewarm retries + clearer quota alerts, and a short runbook. Will post links here when created.

deploy-bot: rollout complete — 12/12 pods ready for ml-infer rev 65.

Maria: Incident mitigated. We'll keep the temporary scheduler flag for one hour and then revert if stable.
